name: Asura-Tainted Gargoyle
journal_prompt: A Māyā-born thing in the shape of a Tuli, its skin calcified into a stone-like hide. It animates only at night, and hunts.
placement_note: Lives on the floating islands. `sky_island` and its neighbours are real canon biomes but are not renderable yet, so the export holds this as lore until a sky mode exists. This is a stated home, not an untagged entity.

taxonomy.notes: Māyā-born, in the shape of a Tuli. The old binomial `Tuli calcified` carried the right subject and the wrong grammar -- Tuli is a people, not a genus, and `calcified` is an English epithet of the kind canon has already replaced twice. Filed as a construct because it is made rather than born, which also settles what had been read as a devolved hominid.

notes: Māyā-born construct in Tuli shape, hide calcified to stone. Nocturnal.
